title: The Five Mysteries of the Covenant
description: The five small customs by which people greet one another in the world — peace, salutation, embrace, right hand, laying on of hands — are in truth the five marks of the covenant by which the rational is sent out from the Lord into its contest with the proprium and brought home again. What the soul performs visibly toward its neighbor is the outer trace of what the Lord performs inwardly toward the soul itself. The five mysteries describe the rational's going forth (peace, hand of strengthening, embrace of love, bowing knee, laying on for commission) and its corresponding return after the contest. The same five gestures recapitulate in the redemption of every soul.
